Dispatch scope = the card's three items in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`: (1) dispatch orders require the dev's own claim comment (session ID + branch, in addition to the PM's), (2) narrow "don't touch the assignee" to exactly the assignee, (3) the PM-claims-at-all question is recorded as a one-line note, not re-litigated — the comment is the load-bearing half either way. Fold-candidate with #11578/#11901/#11936 (dispatch-order discipline amendment family, same file region).
